summary.text: Stephen Spratt is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, and a former state representative who served in the House from 2012 to 2014.

paragraphs.text: Spratt first won election to the New Hampshire House in 2012, representing Hillsborough 4; he was unopposed in the Democratic primary and won the November 6, 2012 general election.
Ballotpedia lists him as taking office on December 5, 2012, and leaving in 2014, and lists a prior office on the Mascenic Regional School District school board.
He advanced from the September 8, 2026 Democratic primary for Hillsborough 36, receiving 666 votes (48.2 percent) in a primary where two candidates advanced.
